tei:div.tei:p: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma zhi khro mngon sangs rgyas/ /theg dgu bcu bdun snying po'i chos/ /chos mdzad don rtogs dge 'dun la/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas 'dud/ /rab tu spros pa med pa yi/ /ku su lu pa'i don ched du/ /tshig don snying po 'bri bar bya/ /ji ltar brjod bya thams cad kun/ /bgrangs pa tsam du zad mod kyang*/ /mdo ni zab mo'i don du bsdus/ /gnas lugs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ /ye shes rnam pa gsum yin no/ /'khrul gzhi rnam pa mang bshad kyang*/ /lhun grub dang ni thugs rje 'o/ /rang gnas sku rig ye shes so/ /gnas pa thugs rjai tsitta'i dkyil/ /lam ni rtsa bzhi 'gyur byed rlung*/ /'char byed sgo ni mig la sogs/ /nam mkha' rkyen bral yul du 'dus/ /nyams blang khregs chod thod rgal lo/ /tshad ni gdeng bzhi'i rnal 'byor nyid/ /bar do ma bu gnyis sbyor ba/ /grol sa nyid ni thog ma 'o/ /zhes rgyud thams cad kyi sdom ste bstan pa'o/ /tshig don snying po zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis/ gangs ri thod dkar du sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o/ / dge'o/ / dge'o// // PAGE - PAGE 311 -
